transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… work’s been getting to me. They changed my warehouse hours and put in this new inventory system, and since then I just haven’t been handling things right. I’ve missed some shifts, missed things at church, been short with my family. Some mornings I’m sitting there with my work boots on and I just… don’t know if I can face going in.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it that way. I guess I still do some things, but I’m not sure I’d say I’m enjoying much right now.
Are there things you used to enjoy that you no longer find pleasure in?
I’m not sure. I mean… I haven’t really been keeping track. I still do some things, but it’s hard to say if I’m getting much pleasure out of them lately.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?

Yeah… I guess I have. Since the hours changed and they brought in that new inventory system, I just feel on edge a lot. Like I’m not keeping up, and some mornings I’m sitting there in my work boots wondering if I can even go in.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time lately?

Yeah… sad, I guess. It’s more like I feel like I’m falling apart since they changed the warehouse hours and put in that new inventory system. I’ve been missing shifts, missing things at church… snapping at my family. Some mornings I just sit there in my work boots and don’t know if I can face going in.
Are there things you used to enjoy that you no longer look forward to?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really thought of it that way. I still do some things, but whether I look forward to them… hard to say.
Are there things that you used to find pleasurable but no longer do?
I’m not sure. I mean… I haven’t really been paying attention to whether things feel pleasurable or not. I just know I’ve been getting through the day, mostly.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
I… I don’t really know. Maybe a little, but I haven’t been thinking about it like that. I’m just trying to get through what’s in front of me.
Have you noticed any change in your weight lately?
I haven’t really noticed, no. I don’t weigh myself much, so… I’m not sure.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
I don’t know… not really anything specific. I mean, I guess I think about things, but I wouldn’t say it’s guilt exactly.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that. Not like… I haven’t made any kind of plan or anything. It’s just not something I like talking about.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself lately?
I… I already kind of said what I can. I don’t have a plan or anything like that. I’d rather not get into it much more.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
Not that I’ve noticed. My clothes seem about the same, I guess.
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit?
No, not really. They fit about the same as far as I can tell.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight since your work hours changed?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed any weight coming off, even with the hours changing.
Have you felt a lack of pleasure in almost all activities for most of the day?
I’m not sure I’d say almost everything. Some things just don’t feel like much lately, but… I don’t know.
How long have you been feeling this way, since the warehouse hours changed and the new inventory system was introduced?
About five months, I guess. Since that new schedule and inventory system started.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the day, nearly every day, since the changes at work started?

Yeah… I guess so. Since all that started at the warehouse, I’ve just felt like I’m kind of falling apart. Some mornings I’m sitting there with my boots on, and I don’t even know if I can make myself go in.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy most of the time since the changes at work?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really been paying attention to it like that. Some things just don’t pull me in the way they used to, I guess.
For how long have you been feeling sad or empty most of the day?
About five months… since they changed the schedule and brought in that new inventory system.
